candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted channel record is directly anchored in the focus surface, and all six nominated branches land through their exact core facets: appointment, stored-resource preservation, custodial office, guarding, knowledge, and land. Together they change the reading from a bare application into a knowing custodian being fitted to a material domain.

The exact HFT trace names 12:36 interpretation, 12:43 dream transfer, and the focus predicates and storehouse, producing a bounded forecast-to-policy relation. The unresolved branches have exact supplied context coordinates and return through the focus knowledge/storehouse surface, so they are retained as attributed evidence.

The trace coordinates the focus appointment and storehouse with the supplied sovereignty, jurisdiction, command, and restraint occurrences in 12:39-12:40. The resulting relation is a bounded delegated office, and every unresolved trace branch is preserved as attributed contextual evidence.

The supplied 12:42 memory-failure sequence has exact forgetting, recall, and delay coordinates and returns to the focus predicates of retention and knowledge. It materially changes personal reliability into institutional memory, with the two unresolved memory traces retained as attributed evidence.

The exact 12:47-12:48 cultivation, persistence, retention, consumption, scarcity, and defended-remainder trace changes stores into an interannual stock-and-flow buffer. All eight nominated branches land; the normalized scarcity branch is retained with its packet facet and the source-coordinate qualification visible in the finding boundary.

The exact 12:51, 12:52, and 12:54 traces place public truth, non-betrayal under absence, clearance, and trust before the focus claim of preservation. The relation survives as qualified fiduciary evidence, with every unresolved branch retained as attributed rather than suppressed.

The trace joins the focus stores, land, guarding, and routing branches to exact 12:56 empowerment, station, place, and loss coordinates. It supports a distributed logistical reading while preserving the live alternative that 12:56 describes Joseph's general empowerment rather than the topology of the office.

The outlier has exact focus carriers for storage, land, and vigilance and an exact 12:48 consumption trigger. Its changed reading is materially distinct and remains bounded as a risk-control analogy rather than a lexical translation; the unresolved consumption branch is retained as attributed.

The outlier's exact 12:36 carrying occurrence and 12:47 scarcity occurrence contact the focus speech and appointment surface. Its form-distant burden reading has a significant payoff and is explicitly retained as associative pressure, with unresolved carrying evidence kept attributed.

The exact dream-interpretation, storehouse, knowledge, and protected-remainder coordinates produce a distinct calibrated-release reading. The financial branch remains an operational resonance that supplements the focus request, and its unresolved branch is retained as attributed evidence.

findings.title: Storehouses require a knowing custodian
findings.claim: The appointment request joins a defined storehouse domain to preservation, custodial responsibility, active guarding, and knowledgeable oversight.
findings.mechanism: The focus imperative supplies placement into a role; the plural stores supply the material object; the custodian and guarding facets specify the operation; knowledge and land specify competence and jurisdiction. Their contact turns the two predicates into a fit between what must be preserved and who can preserve it.
findings.reader_payoff: The request becomes a concrete administrative fit: knowledge is visible as the capacity that makes the stores preservable across their terrestrial domain.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains Joseph's request to be appointed over the land's treasures and his claim to be a good keeper and knower. The activated facets add role and operation without making every dictionary branch of the six roots active.

epistemic.reason: All six focus carriers and their core facet statements are independently present in the accepted focus branch registry, and the channel support explicitly binds their relation on 12:55.

The two unresolved 12:36 traces attribute taking charge and governing an affair to the same interpretive contact, so knowledge is read as a capacity to turn a forecast into policy.
findings.reader_payoff: The word for knowing now explains why Joseph's earlier interpretation can become a qualification for managing reserves: the reader sees a passage from understood sign to public action.
findings.containment: The ordinary sentence still says that Joseph claims knowledge suited to the stores. This finding adds an interpretive-to-administrative relation; it does not make the word for knowledge a title for dream interpretation. The supplied alternative remains that the narrative sequence, rather than the lexical branches, carries the administrative link.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact focus and context coordinates and a complete before/after relation, but its unresolved branches and source identity require attributed qualification.
